summary: This standards-track document registers the mailserver: URI scheme as historic in the IANA registry. The scheme was defined long ago for pointing to mail servers but was never meaningfully used, so it should not be used in new software. Marking it historic tells people it is retired.

plainLanguage.summary: The mailserver: URI scheme was registered without enough detail to make implementations work together. This RFC moves it to Historic and names better-defined URI schemes for related uses.

subtitle: Registers the undocumented mailserver: URI scheme as Historic.

tldr.problem: The mailserver: scheme had only a vague description and no usable syntax, making implementations incompatible.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC discourages future implementations and asks IANA to register the scheme as Historic.
tldr.outcome: The scheme is Historic; the RFC points to mailto, imap, pop, or http URI schemes for specific tasks.

today: RFC 6196 updates RFC 1738 and registers the mailserver: URI scheme as Historic. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates RFC 6196.

sections.title: Why the Scheme Is Retired
sections.content:
RFC 1738 registered mailserver: provisionally as access to data available from mail servers but provided no further details. The RFC's author knew of no more complete definition, so the scheme was not interoperable.

The document discourages future implementations to avoid software inventing undocumented syntax and asks IANA to mark the scheme Historic.
sections.plainLanguage: The scheme did not explain how its addresses should work. Retiring it discourages incompatible guesses.

sections.title: URI Schemes to Use Instead
sections.content:
For instructions to generate an email message, the RFC points to mailto:. To reference messages in a mail store, it points to imap:, pop:, or http: URIs, according to the relevant service.

The document records that previous attempts to define the mailserver scheme in more detail were unsuccessful.
sections.plainLanguage: Use a URI scheme defined for the task: mailto for composing a message, or imap, pop, and http for references to stored messages.

sections.title: Registry and Security Status
sections.content:
IANA re-registered mailserver: as Historic in the URI scheme registry and changed the reference to this document. The RFC updates RFC 1738.

The security section notes that the scheme was never properly documented and that there were no known implementations.
sections.plainLanguage: The registry now labels mailserver: as Historic. The RFC reports no known implementations of the scheme.
